# Article charts (generated by make_charts.py; do not edit by hand)

Regenerate: `cd <BENCH> && python3 make_charts.py` (matplotlib Agg, no network). Every figure is recomputed from `results/series<N>/rows.csv` joined with the verified verdicts and checked against FACTS before drawing. Series 7 and 14: the Codex "Model metadata not found" warning (counted as an `other` call) is detected by that phrase in the run's jsonl and subtracted once per run, as SERIES7.md and SERIES14.md do. Series 5 verdicts come from the hand-checked `manual` column of the SERIES5.md per-run table.

## 03-heldout-per-task-calls
Files: `03-heldout-per-task-calls.png`, `.svg`. FACTS: F-LA-2, F-LA-5, F-LA-9, F-LA-10, F-MM-1. Kinds are the `kind` field of `tasks_heldout.json` (locate, read, structure, crossref, multihop; there is no separate search or summary kind).

| task | kind | DevX calls | native calls | DevX correct | native correct |
|--|--|--|--|--|--|
| H-L1 | locate | 1 | 1 | yes | yes |
| H-L2 | locate | 1 | 1 | yes | yes |
| H-L3 | locate | 1 | 1 | yes | yes |
| H-R1 | read | 1 | 1 | yes | yes |
| H-R2 | read | 2 | 3 | yes | yes |
| H-R3 | read | 1 | 2 | yes | yes |
| H-S1 | structure | 1 | 0 | NO | NO |
| H-S2 | structure | 1 | 1 | yes | yes |
| H-X1 | crossref | 1 | 3 | yes | yes |
| H-X2 | crossref | 4 | 1 | yes | NO |
| H-M1 | multihop | 0 | 1 | NO | yes |
| H-M2 | multihop | 2 | 2 | yes | yes |

Caption: Series 5, tool calls per task grouped by kind (gpt-6-luna, Codex CLI, 12 tasks, one run each). Hatched bars are wrong answers (hand-checked); the task kind 'structure' is the held-out set's name for the structure/summary questions.
